cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.
